import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import test from 'node:test';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import { buildSync } from 'esbuild';
import ts from 'typescript';

type Node = {
  tag: string;
  attrs: Record<string, string>;
  children: (Node | string)[];
};
type Action = {
  tag: string;
  attrs: Record<string, string>;
  ancestors: Record<string, string>[];
};
type Fixture = {
  id: string;
  page: string;
  title: string;
  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
  expectedText: string[];
};
const requireNative = createRequire(__filename);
const { parsePreviewWxml: parse, evaluatePreviewExpression: evaluate } =
  requireNative('../scripts/preview-wxml.mjs') as {
    parsePreviewWxml(source: string): Node;
    evaluatePreviewExpression(
      expression: string,
      scope: Record<string, unknown>,
    ): unknown;
  };
const { default: fixtures } = requireNative(
  '../scripts/fixtures/school-operations-preview.mjs',
) as { default: Fixture[] };
const root = path.join(__dirname, '../src');
const read = (file: string) => readFileSync(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
const source = (page: string, extension = 'wxml') =>
  read(`pages/${page}/${page}.${extension}`);
const inventory = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(
    path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/school-operations-action-inventory.json'),
    'utf8',
  ),
) as {
  pages: Record<string, Action[]>;
  sharedTemplates: Record<string, Action[]>;
  protectedHashes: Record<string, string>;
  registrars: Record<string, { baselineTokens: string }>;
};
const guards = [
  'wx:if',
  'wx:elif',
  'wx:else',
  'wx:for',
  'wx:for-item',
  'wx:for-index',
  'wx:key',
];
const relevant = (attrs: Record<string, string>) =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(attrs).filter(
      ([key]) =>
        /^(bind|catch|data-)/.test(key) ||
        [
          ...guards,
          'url',
          'disabled',
          'loading',
          'maxlength',
          'min',
          'max',
          'type',
          'value',
          'checked',
          'mode',
          'range',
          'id',
          'for',
        ].includes(key),
    ),
  );
function actions(
  node: Node | string,
  ancestors: Record<string, string>[] = [],
): Action[] {
  if (typeof node === 'string') return [];
  const guard = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(node.attrs).filter(([key]) => guards.includes(key)),
  );
  const own =
    [
      'navigator',
      'input',
      'textarea',
      'switch',
      'picker',
      'radio',
      'checkbox',
    ].includes(node.tag) ||
    Object.keys(node.attrs).some((key) => /^(bind|catch)/.test(key));
  return [
    ...(own ? [{ tag: node.tag, attrs: relevant(node.attrs), ancestors }] : []),
    ...node.children.flatMap((child) =>
      actions(
        child,
        Object.keys(guard).length ? [...ancestors, guard] : ancestors,
      ),
    ),
  ];
}
for (const [page, baseline] of Object.entries(inventory.pages)) {
  test(`${page}: retains every original action, target, input constraint and authority ancestor`, () => {
    const current = actions(parse(source(page)));
    for (const old of baseline) {
      const index = current.findIndex(
        (candidate) =>
          candidate.tag === old.tag &&
          Object.entries(old.attrs).every(
            ([key, value]) => candidate.attrs[key] === value,
          ) &&
          old.ancestors.every((guard) =>
            candidate.ancestors.some((ancestor) =>
              Object.entries(guard).every(
                ([key, value]) => ancestor[key] === value,
              ),
            ),
          ),
      );
      assert.notEqual(
        index,
        -1,
        `Missing or weakened action: ${JSON.stringify(old)}`,
      );
      current.splice(index, 1);
    }
  });
}
test('49 authority, identity, journal, CAS, recovery, gateway and shared confirmation files are unchanged', () => {
  for (const [file, expected] of Object.entries(inventory.protectedHashes))
    assert.equal(
      createHash('sha256').update(read(file)).digest('hex'),
      expected,
      file,
    );
  for (const [file, baseline] of Object.entries(inventory.sharedTemplates))
    assert.deepEqual(actions(parse(read(file))), baseline, file);
});
test('all ten pages use isolated native icon and semantic light/dark presentation', () => {
  for (const page of Object.keys(inventory.pages)) {
    const wxml = source(page);
    assert.match(wxml, /class="screen ops-page /);
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      wxml,
      /WHALEU ·|<view class="title"|https?:\/\/|openid|studentNumber|identityView/,
    );
    assert.match(source(page, 'wxss'), /school-operations\/presentation\.wxss/);
    const json = JSON.parse(source(page, 'json')) as {
      usingComponents: Record<string, string>;
    };
    assert.equal(json.usingComponents['wu-icon'], '../../components/icon/icon');
  }
  const css = read('school-operations/presentation.wxss');
  assert.match(css, /prefers-color-scheme: dark/);
  assert.match(css, /env\(safe-area-inset-bottom\)/);
  assert.match(css, /background: var\(--wu-elevated\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(css, /box-shadow|linear-gradient|@import.*app\.wxss/);
});

function tokenHash(source: string): string {
  const scanner = ts.createScanner(
    ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
    true,
    ts.LanguageVariant.Standard,
    source,
  );
  const tokens: string[] = [];
  while (scanner.scan() !== ts.SyntaxKind.EndOfFileToken)
    tokens.push(scanner.getTokenText());
  return createHash('sha256')
    .update(
      JSON.stringify(
        tokens.filter(
          (token, index) =>
            token !== ',' || !['}', ']', ')'].includes(tokens[index + 1] ?? ''),
        ),
      ),
    )
    .digest('hex');
}
for (const [page, baseline] of Object.entries(inventory.registrars)) {
  test(`${page}: every original page handler is unchanged apart from transient disclosure state`, () => {
    const file = ts.createSourceFile(
      `${page}.ts`,
      source(page, 'ts'),
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
    );
    const transformed = ts.transform(file, [
      (context) => (sourceFile) => {
        const visit: ts.Visitor = (node) => {
          if (
            ts.isMethodDeclaration(node) &&
            node.name.getText(file) === 'onToggleUiPanel'
          )
            return undefined;
          if (
            ts.isPropertyAssignment(node) &&
            node.name.getText(file) === 'uiPanel'
          )
            return undefined;
          if (
            ts.isSpreadAssignment(node) &&
            node.expression.getText(file).includes('uiPanel')
          )
            return undefined;
          if (
            ts.isExpressionStatement(node) &&
            ts.isCallExpression(node.expression)
          ) {
            const call = node.expression;
            if (
              call.expression.getText(file) === 'this.setData' &&
              call.arguments.length === 1
            ) {
              const argument = call.arguments[0]!;
              if (
                ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(argument) &&
                argument.properties.length === 1 &&
                ts.isPropertyAssignment(argument.properties[0]!) &&
                argument.properties[0]!.name.getText(file) === 'uiPanel'
              )
                return undefined;
            }
          }
          return ts.visitEachChild(node, visit, context);
        };
        return ts.visitNode(sourceFile, visit) as ts.SourceFile;
      },
    ]);
    try {
      assert.equal(
        tokenHash(ts.createPrinter().printFile(transformed.transformed[0]!)),
        baseline.baselineTokens,
        page,
      );
    } finally {
      transformed.dispose();
    }
  });
}

type MockPage = {
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
  setData(patch: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  onToggleUiPanel(event: {
    currentTarget: { dataset: { panel: string } };
  }): void;
  onHide(): void;
  onShow(): void;
  onUnload(): void;
};
for (const page of Object.keys(inventory.pages)) {
  test(`${page}: disclosures toggle without requests and reset on Hide/Show/Unload`, () => {
    let definition: MockPage | undefined;
    const result = buildSync({
      entryPoints: [path.join(root, `pages/${page}/${page}.ts`)],
      bundle: true,
      write: false,
      platform: 'node',
      format: 'cjs',
      logLevel: 'silent',
    });
    vm.runInNewContext(result.outputFiles[0]!.text, {
      Page(value: MockPage) {
        definition = value;
      },
      wx: {},
      getApp: () => ({}),
      require(name: string) {
        assert.equal(name, 'crypto');
        return requireNative(name);
      },
    });
    assert.ok(definition);
    const instance = definition;
    instance.setData = (patch) => {
      instance.data = { ...instance.data, ...patch };
    };
    const tap = { currentTarget: { dataset: { panel: 'details' } } };
    instance.onToggleUiPanel(tap);
    assert.equal(instance.data.uiPanel, 'details');
    instance.onToggleUiPanel(tap);
    assert.equal(instance.data.uiPanel, '');
    instance.onToggleUiPanel(tap);
    instance.onHide();
    assert.equal(instance.data.uiPanel, '');
    instance.onToggleUiPanel(tap);
    instance.onShow();
    assert.equal(instance.data.uiPanel, '');
    instance.onToggleUiPanel(tap);
    instance.onUnload();
    assert.equal(instance.data.uiPanel, '');
  });
}

function templates(
  file: string,
  found: Record<string, (Node | string)[]> = {},
) {
  for (const node of parse(read(file)).children) {
    if (typeof node === 'string') continue;
    if (node.tag === 'import')
      templates(path.join(path.dirname(file), node.attrs.src!), found);
    if (node.tag === 'template' && node.attrs.name)
      found[node.attrs.name] = node.children;
  }
  return found;
}
const interpolate = (text: string, scope: Record<string, unknown>) =>
  text.replace(/{{([\s\S]*?)}}/g, (_, expression: string) =>
    String(evaluate(expression, scope) ?? ''),
  );
function render(
  nodes: (Node | string)[],
  scope: Record<string, unknown>,
  named: Record<string, (Node | string)[]>,
): string {
  let result = '',
    matched = false;
  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (typeof node === 'string') {
      result += interpolate(node, scope) + ' ';
      continue;
    }
    const attrs = node.attrs;
    if (node.tag === 'import' || (node.tag === 'template' && attrs.name))
      continue;
    if (attrs['wx:for']) {
      const { ['wx:for']: loop, ...other } = attrs;
      const values = evaluate(loop.slice(2, -2), scope) as
        unknown[] | undefined;
      for (const [index, item] of (values ?? []).entries())
        result += render(
          [{ ...node, attrs: other }],
          {
            ...scope,
            [attrs['wx:for-item'] ?? 'item']: item,
            [attrs['wx:for-index'] ?? 'index']: index,
          },
          named,
        );
      continue;
    }
    if ('wx:if' in attrs) matched = false;
    if ('wx:elif' in attrs && matched) continue;
    const condition = attrs['wx:if'] ?? attrs['wx:elif'];
    if (condition !== undefined) {
      if (!evaluate(condition.slice(2, -2), scope)) continue;
      matched = true;
    } else if ('wx:else' in attrs) {
      if (matched) continue;
      matched = true;
    } else matched = false;
    if (node.tag === 'template' && attrs.is) {
      result += render(
        named[attrs.is] ?? [],
        evaluate(`({${attrs.data!.slice(2, -2)}})`, scope) as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
        named,
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (['input', 'textarea'].includes(node.tag))
      result += interpolate(attrs.value ?? '', scope) + ' ';
    result += render(node.children, scope, named);
  }
  return result.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}
for (const fixture of fixtures) {
  test(`synthetic source fixture ${fixture.id} renders strict state-specific markers`, () => {
    assert.ok(fixture.expectedText.length > 0);
    const output = render(
      parse(source(fixture.page)).children,
      fixture.patch,
      templates(`pages/${fixture.page}/${fixture.page}.wxml`),
    );
    for (const marker of fixture.expectedText)
      assert.ok(
        output.includes(marker),
        `${fixture.id}: missing ${marker}\n${output}`,
      );
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      output,
      /\{\{|\}\}|undefined|\[object Object\]|https?:\/\//,
    );
  });
}
test('fixtures cover all registered pages and every critical permission/recovery state without live data', () => {
  assert.equal(
    new Set(fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.id)).size,
    fixtures.length,
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...new Set(fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.page))].sort(),
    Object.keys(inventory.pages).sort(),
  );
  for (const page of Object.keys(inventory.pages)) {
    assert.ok(
      fixtures.some(
        (fixture) => fixture.page === page && !fixture.id.includes('denied'),
      ),
    );
    assert.ok(
      fixtures.some(
        (fixture) => fixture.page === page && fixture.id.includes('denied'),
      ),
    );
  }
  for (const state of ['expired', 'confirm', 'cancel', 'recovery', 'protected'])
    assert.ok(
      fixtures.some((fixture) => fixture.id.includes(state)),
      state,
    );
  assert.doesNotMatch(
    JSON.stringify(fixtures),
    /https?:\/\/|studentNumber|accessToken|refreshToken|openid|passport/,
  );
});
test('confirmation warnings, unknown-result barriers and distinct topic/reply policy wording stay explicit', () => {
  assert.match(
    source('school-admin-management'),
    /失去当前管理权限后仍可由原账号查询回执/,
  );
  assert.match(
    source('school-identity-management'),
    /号码永久保留在历史中，不能重新使用/,
  );
  assert.match(source('school-identity-management'), /现有认证有效期不会延长/);
  assert.match(source('school-posting-policy'), /允许未认证用户回复/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(
    source('school-posting-policy'),
    /回复／回复|此页不提供关联学校同步开关/,
  );
  assert.match(
    source('school-posting-policy'),
    /重试会保留原始内容、版本和请求标识/,
  );
  assert.match(
    source('official-account-operations'),
    /开发合成模式 · 无真实公众号连接 · 不会自动发布/,
  );
  assert.match(source('announcement-edit'), /只有发布后才对相应浏览者可见/);
  assert.match(source('errand-restrictions'), /没有记录不能解释为从未受限/);
});
